comparison.objective: Place one block on a shared tower after another robot acts, without arm contact.
comparison.physical_skill: Turn-taking, collision avoidance, block pick-and-place, and stable stacking.
comparison.success_condition: Green block centered and level on the tower; any arm-arm contact invalidates success.
comparison.reason: The candidate tests coaxial mandrel placement, contact-driven notch fracture, controlled hammer impact, retained-coil protection, and recovery of four free tangs. Shared stabilization and placement primitives do not test the same ability.
